wiz.s1.title: Welcome! I'm Mochi
wiz.s1.text: I'll help you with the shopping list and with finding good deals. First, choose your language.
wiz.s2.title: Your shared list
wiz.s2.b1: Write “2 kg apples” or “milk, bread, eggs”: one tap and they're added.
wiz.s2.b2: Every product goes into the right aisle by itself.
wiz.s2.b3: Tick off what you've got: when the list is done, there's a party!
wiz.s3.title: Share it with your family
wiz.s3.text: The list syncs through a file in your Dropbox. You can do it now or later in Settings.
wiz.s3.b1: Connect Dropbox: no server, no account to create.
wiz.s3.b2: Send your family the ready-made link.
wiz.s3.b3: It also works offline: changes merge on their own.
wiz.s4.title: Deals and good buys
wiz.s4.b1: Choose the products to watch, like detergent or fabric softener.
wiz.s4.b2: Mochi searches the flyers near home and compares them with Amazon.
wiz.s4.b3: Paste a link or a price: you'll find out if it's good value.
wiz.s4.b4: AI search is optional and uses your keys (free services exist).
wiz.s5.title: Privacy and terms
wiz.s5.b1: Your data stays on your phone and in your Dropbox.
wiz.s5.b2: No tracking, no ads, no analytics.
wiz.s5.b3: Product names and area go to external services (AI, prices, maps) only when you use them.
wiz.s5.b4: Prices are indicative: always check the source.
wiz.s5.accept: I have read and accept the privacy notice and the terms of use
wiz.s5.must: To continue, please tick the box to accept.
legal.title: Privacy and terms of use
legal.reaccept: We have updated the privacy notice and the terms of use. Please read and accept them to continue.
legal.p1: Mochi Spesa has no server: the list, deals and settings are saved on your device (browser storage).
legal.p2: If you connect Dropbox, the shared list is saved as a file in your Dropbox account. Dropbox's privacy policy applies to it.
legal.p3: Dropbox access tokens, your name and service keys (AI, SerpApi) stay on this device and are never sent to us. If you choose to share AI keys with your family, they're also saved in the Dropbox file, as is the Cloudflare bridge address if you enter it.
legal.p4: If you use AI searches and ratings, product names, area, prices and links are sent with your key to the service you set up: Groq, Mistral AI, Alibaba Cloud (Qwen), OpenRouter, SiliconFlow or Anthropic. Each handles them under its own privacy policy; some are based outside the EU (for example in the USA, China or Singapore) and free plans may use requests to train models.
legal.p5: The app uses no cookies, analytics, ads or tracking.
legal.p6: Fonts and libraries are served from the app's site (GitHub Pages), which like any website receives your IP address.
legal.p7: You can delete everything at any time: clear the browser data and the file in Dropbox.
legal.p8: Do not enter sensitive personal data in the list.
legal.t1: Mochi Spesa is free software under the MIT licence, provided “as is”, without warranty of any kind.
legal.t2: Prices, deals and ratings come from web sources and from an AI model: they may be wrong or out of date. Always check the source before buying.
legal.t3: Mochi Spesa isn't affiliated with Amazon, Dropbox, Cloudflare, SerpApi, AI services or the shops mentioned. Trademarks belong to their owners.
legal.t4: Searches and ratings use your accounts (AI services, SerpApi, Cloudflare): costs and limits are your responsibility.
legal.t5: Use the app for personal purposes and in compliance with the terms of the sites consulted.
legal.t6: The authors are not liable for purchases, losses or damage resulting from use of the app.
legal.t7: These terms may change: you will be asked to accept them again.

new.deals: Deals near home compared with Amazon.

install.title: Install Mochi Spesa
install.text: Add it to your home screen: it opens like an app and also works offline.
install.ios: On iPhone: tap {share} Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
install.done: Installed! Find Mochi on your home screen
geo.ok: Home set to your current location

geo.away: You're about {km} km from home, near {place}. Search for deals here?
geo.geocodeFail: I can't find this address on the map: I'll use the text as it is.
legal.p9: Location is used only if you allow it in the browser and is rounded to about 1 km. Home address, coordinates and country are saved in the shared settings; the country is used to pick currency, Amazon store and local results. To turn addresses into places the app queries OpenStreetMap (Nominatim), which receives the address or coordinates.
new.install: Mochi offers to install itself on your home screen.
new.easyDbx: Connecting Dropbox now takes one tap: no codes to type.
new.geo: Home address and location: away from home, Mochi offers deals where you are.
voice.listening: I'm listening… say for example “milk, bread and eggs”
voice.none: I didn't hear anything, try again.
legal.p10: Voice dictation uses the speech recognition built into your browser: on Chrome the audio is processed by Google, on Safari by Apple. It only starts when you tap the microphone.
new.voice: Dictate your shopping list by voice, for free.

new.swipe: Swipe to delete with Undo, and a button for quantities.

pantry.levelsHelp: Levels separated by commas, e.g. 1, 2, 3 or Top, Bottom. Renaming a shelf or level moves its products too.
new.racks: Drawn shelves with levels: tap a level to see what's there. New shelf and level editor.
new.lvdir: In settings, choose whether levels are counted from the top or the bottom.
free.moreWithKey: For today's flyers add a key in settings: Mistral has a free plan.
free.info: Without a key Mochi uses prices reported by the Open Food Facts community: they're few and not always recent. To search today's flyers add a key in settings (Mistral has a free plan).
legal.p11: Price search also uses Open Prices (Open Food Facts), which receives the area's coordinates rounded to about 1 km.
new.savebar: Settings: one bar with Cancel and Save.
new.free: Free price search, no key needed, with Open Food Facts community prices.
legal.p12: If you add a SerpApi key, the searched product name and the country are sent to SerpApi (USA), which searches Amazon and Google Shopping. If the browser blocks the direct call, the request goes through your Cloudflare bridge together with the key.
new.mistral: Free flyer search with Mistral: pick the service and paste a free key.
fl.title: Read a flyer
fl.hint: Upload a PDF or photo of a flyer, even an old one: Mochi looks for your list and watched products and saves the prices. The file is read on your phone.
fl.loading: Downloading the text reader (first time only)…
fl.needProducts: First add some products to the list or to watch.
fl.none: No products from your list found in this flyer.
fl.foundHint: Check the prices read and untick wrong ones. Shop:
legal.p13: Flyers you upload are read on the phone: the file isn't sent to anyone. The reading engine (OCR) and the language model are downloaded from jsDelivr, which receives your IP address. Prices read end up in the shared Dropbox file.
new.flyer: Read flyers (PDF or photo) for free on your phone and keep a history of the best prices.
ai.share: Share the keys with people using the same list
ai.shareHint: They're saved in the shared Dropbox file, so others don't need their own. Only share with people you trust: whoever has a key uses your account.
ch.title: Your chains
ch.hint: Mochi downloads these chains' official flyers by itself and looks for your products. The flyer is read on your phone.
ch.none: The official flyer bridge isn't active yet.
legal.p14: If you turn on the Cloudflare bridge (your own, created on your account), the app downloads chains' official flyers and SerpApi searches through it. The bridge only accepts official sites and SerpApi; Cloudflare caches pages and flyers for up to 6 hours and sees the request's IP address, not your list.
new.chains: Official flyers automatically: pick your chains and Mochi finds your products' prices by itself.
ai.keysHint: You can add several keys, free ones too: Mochi picks the right one for each task (with or without web search), uses free ones first and moves to the next when one runs out of quota.
ai.none: No AI key: add one (free services exist).
ai.allBusy: All keys are paused by usage limits: try again later.
ai.p.mistral: European company. Free plan with limits; on the free plan requests may be used to train models.
ai.p.groq: Free with daily limits, no card. Open models such as Qwen (Chinese); searches the web with “groq/compound”.
ai.p.qwen: Alibaba (China). Free credit for new users, valid 90 days: turn on “Free quota only” to never pay.
ai.p.openrouter: Free models, Chinese ones too (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM), with about 50 requests a day.
ai.p.siliconflow: Chinese platform with free models (Qwen, GLM, DeepSeek); may ask for identity verification.
ai.p.claude: Paid; the most accurate for web searches.
legal.p15: “My prices” (prices collected from flyers, searches and manual entries) stays only on this phone.

new.multikey: Several AI keys, free ones too (Groq, Qwen, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow): Mochi picks the best for each task.
new.pricedb: “My prices”: every price from the flyers you read in a searchable database on your phone.

zone.osm: Shop list from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors)
legal.p16: To show nearby shops, the (rounded) centre of your area and the radius are sent to OpenStreetMap (Overpass API). The list is kept on your phone for 7 days.
new.nearshops: Favourite shops without typing: pick from the shops within your radius.
new.amazon: Amazon comparison: one tap opens the product on Amazon, and Amazon prices you save in “My prices” join the comparisons.

kapibo.label: Exchange with Kapibo (home budget)
kapibo.settingHint: If you use Kapibo on this phone, shopping you put away can become an expense in your budget and receipts read by Kapibo can go into your pantry. Everything stays on the phone.
kapibo.sendP: Send the shopping you just put away (products: {n}) to Kapibo, to add it to your home budget? It will only ask for the prices.

new.kapibo: Mochi talks to Kapibo: receipts read by Kapibo go into your pantry and shopping you put away can go into your budget.
new.bestv2: More precise “Find the best price”: it checks the flyers of nearby chains one by one, flyer aggregators, online grocery shops and Amazon, and drops other formats (e.g. tablets when you search pods).
sync.newer: List made with a newer version: update the app to save
new.syncformat: Sturdier sync: data from other apps and versions is no longer lost
serp.title: Real prices from Amazon and online shops
serp.hint: With a free SerpApi key (250 searches a month) Mochi reads real prices from Amazon and from the online shops gathered by Google Shopping. Each search uses 2 and is kept for 24 hours.
serp.off: Off: without a key, Amazon and online shops are only searched by the AI, with fewer results.
serp.step2: Copy the key from the page
serp.removeConfirm: Delete the SerpApi key from this phone?
new.serp: Real prices from Amazon and online shops with a free SerpApi key; search drops other formats and shops outside your radius.
ch.pagesHint: Open your shop's flyer page on the official website and paste its link here: Mochi checks it every day and reads the PDF it publishes. Supported sites: {list}.
ch.pageBad: This link isn't from a supported official site ({list}).
new.flyers2: Official flyers of your shops (Todis, Eurospin, MD, Conad…) from their page link, and several flyer screenshots read together, also via “Share”.
ch.ponteHint: Copy it from Cloudflare after creating the Worker (it ends with .workers.dev). Enter it on one phone: it's shared with the family.
new.ponte: The bridge for official flyers can be turned on without a token: create the Worker on Cloudflare and paste its address in the settings.
ch.ponteSteps: You need a Cloudflare and a GitHub account, both free. Tap the button, sign in and confirm “Deploy”: then copy here the address ending in .workers.dev and save. The bridge is yours: it only uses your free quota.
new.ponte2: Easier bridge for official flyers: one button creates it for free on your Cloudflare account, and “Test” checks it works.
dbx.setupConfirm: You opened a setup link. Use it? The list will be synced to the file {path} on Dropbox (App key {key}). Only accept if the link comes from someone you trust.
legal.p17: For questions or reports open an issue on GitHub: github.com/Marketto/mochi-spesa/issues. Issues are public: don't write personal data.
